* @spec c0b1 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V

.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 480n
meas tran c0b0 FIND v(q0) AT=30n
meas tran c0b1 FIND v(q1) AT=30n
meas tran c1b0 FIND v(q0) AT=70n
meas tran c1b1 FIND v(q1) AT=70n
meas tran c2b0 FIND v(q0) AT=110n
meas tran c2b1 FIND v(q1) AT=110n
meas tran c3b0 FIND v(q0) AT=150n
meas tran c3b1 FIND v(q1) AT=150n
meas tran c4b0 FIND v(q0) AT=190n
meas tran c4b1 FIND v(q1) AT=190n
meas tran c5b0 FIND v(q0) AT=230n
meas tran c5b1 FIND v(q1) AT=230n
meas tran c6b0 FIND v(q0) AT=270n
meas tran c6b1 FIND v(q1) AT=270n
meas tran c7b0 FIND v(q0) AT=310n
meas tran c7b1 FIND v(q1) AT=310n
meas tran c8b0 FIND v(q0) AT=350n
meas tran c8b1 FIND v(q1) AT=350n
meas tran c9b0 FIND v(q0) AT=390n
meas tran c9b1 FIND v(q1) AT=390n
meas tran c10b0 FIND v(q0) AT=430n
meas tran c10b1 FIND v(q1) AT=430n
meas tran c11b0 FIND v(q0) AT=470n
meas tran c11b1 FIND v(q1) AT=470n
write out.raw v(q0) v(q1) v(se) v(si) v(clk)
quit
.endc
.end
